m.s: Heat the oven to 160°C fan-forced. Grease and line a loaf tin, about 22cm x 10cm, with baking paper.
Mash {banana} in a big bowl with a fork. The browner and spottier they are, the sweeter the loaf will be.
Melt {butter} and whisk it into the banana with {brownsugar}, {eggs} and {vanilla} until well combined.
Sift in {flour}, {bicarb}, {bakingpowder}, {cinnamon} and a pinch of salt. Fold together gently until just combined. A few lumps are fine.
Pour into the tin and bake for 55 to 60 minutes, until a skewer in the middle comes out clean. If the top is browning too fast, cover it loosely with foil for the last 15 minutes.
Cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a rack. Slice once it's cooled, and toast slices with butter to serve.

g: Use GF plain flour and add an extra ½ tsp baking powder to help it rise. Check the baking powder label.
k: Keeps for 4 days wrapped up on the bench. Freeze it in slices and toast straight from frozen.
